project_type: Python trading bot application (ICT concepts, MetaTrader 5 integration)
test_framework: pytest with unittest.mock for MT5 mocking
verification_instructions:
1. Install dependencies: pip install -r requirements.txt
2. Run tests: pytest tests/ -v
3. Run linting: python -m py_compile on all source files
4. Verify imports work: python -c 'from ict_bot import *'
setup_instructions:
1. pip install -r requirements.txt
2. Copy config/config_example.yaml to config/config.yaml and fill in MT5/Telegram credentials
3. Run: python main.py
environment_constraints: MetaTrader5 package only works on Windows with MT5 terminal installed. Tests must mock MT5 calls. Telegram bot token needed for notifications. Python 3.9 available in sandbox.
contribution_requirements: Greenfield project - no existing contribution guidelines
key_patterns: Modular design with each ICT concept as a separate module. Sequential confirmation entry model (Liquidity Sweep -> MSS -> FVG -> Entry). Multi-timeframe analysis (Daily/4H for bias, 15m for context, 1m for execution).
directory_structure: Root: main.py entry point, requirements.txt, config/ for YAML configs. ict_bot/ package with modules for each ICT concept. tests/ for pytest test files.
